messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: ingress-proxy 5xx spike detected (5m window). 90th p95 latency increased, 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 6.8%. Root request path: /v1/generate. Trigger: error-rate-threshold:critical. Correlation sample id: cId=3f2a9b7e.

alex: paging oncall (I'm up) — I'm grabbing logs and starting a timeline. How widespread is this? which regions/instances?

maria: seeing it in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Host groups: ingress-gw-{a,b,c}. 10% of requests to /v1/generate return 502/504. Some 503s for streaming connections.

irene: customers impacted: 12 tenants, ~1.8k reqs/min failing. Not seeing auth errors; failures are backend/upstream related. Customer support notified.

sam: quick hypothesis: upstream runtime instances overloaded + client retries amplifying. Also noticed an increase in connection resets (RST).

alex: collecting kvlogs for the sample correlation id. Sharing quick grep output:

```
$ rg "3f2a9b7e" /var/log/ingress/*.log | head -n 20
ingress-gw-a.log: [2026-03-15T14:12:02Z] req=3f2a9b7e path=/v1/generate upstream=runtime-12 status=502 backend_err="upstream read timeout"
ingress-gw-b.log: [2026-03-15T14:12:02Z] req=3f2a9b7e path=/v1/generate upstream=runtime-12 status=502
runtime-12.log: [2026-03-15T14:12:01Z] req=3f2a9b7e kv_cache_hit=false processing_ms=2340 queue_ms=1200
```

alex: looks like runtime-12 had long processing + queue wait. queue_ms around 1200ms on that trace.

kyle: checking runtime pool metrics — runtime-12 CPU < 70% but high GPU utilization for a subset of requests. Kernel-level queuing indicates KV cache miss causes full model run.

ops-bot: Attached: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2253456789/kvlogs.tar.gz (contains kv traces and raw ingress logs).

maria: putting together a short timeline for handoff:
- 14:07Z: minor tail latency bump starts on ingress-gw-a/b
- 14:11Z: retry amplification threshold hit (clients retrying x2)
- 14:12Z: sharp increase in 502/504; pager fired (oncall-bot)
- 14:13Z: initial mitigation: increased ingress connection pool to +20% on gw-c (hotfix)
- 14:15Z: some reduction but 5xx still persistent

alex: mitigation suggestion 1: temporarily route traffic away from runtime-12 to runtime-17/18 (health check shows both healthy) — can we quickly update the smart-router route policy for this tenant cohort? If yes, do it as a canary first.

irene: mitigation suggestion 2: reduce client-side retry multiplier for public tier via edge header rewrite so we don't worsen amplification. Can we insert `x-retry-hint: 1` for requests matching /v1/generate?

sam: I'm on routing changes. Doing a canary reroute for 5% of traffic off runtime-12 -> runtime-17. Command:

```
# admin-cli route update --selector runtime=runtime-12 --shift 5% --to runtime-17 --dry-run=false
```

sam: canary applied. Observing metrics in the next 60s.

(30s pause)

sam: canary looks good: 5xx from the rerouted cohort ~0.4% vs 6.6% on runtime-12. Scaling plan: spin up 2 extra runtime pods in us-west-2, and evict the oldest runtime-12 worker.

kyle: scaling runtime pool +2 started. Eviction scheduled after warmup to avoid cold start spike.

alex: also let's capture full request traces for 30m for affected tenants (sample rate 100% for the cohort). Use `trace-collector` to store to secure-bucket.

ops-bot: Tracing mode enabled for tenant-cohort:ID=tc-112 (30m). Location: gs://redwood-traces/2253456789/

maria: customer impact note for post-incident report: affected endpoints were non-stream generation only; streaming connections had intermittent resets but not full outages. Estimated error budget impact: ~0.5% of daily requests (prelim). We'll refine with raw logs.

irene: collecting sample request bodies for failed attempts to rule out input edge-case causing slowdowns.

alex: new hypothesis after initial mitigations: a small set of requests cause heavy KV cache miss and full decode (e.g., extremely long contexts), which stalls worker GPUs and increases queue_ms; combined with client retries this starves other requests leading to gateway 502/504.

sam: supporting evidence from runtime logs: multiple large tokensize entries around the same time. Example: `prompt_tokens=18904` for some requests. We're hitting model max window fallback which triggers longer processing paths.

kyle: action items (in-thread):
1) preserve logs + set pin: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2253456789/ (ops-bot already).
2) increase per-worker queue limit (temporarily) and adjust admission-control to favor shorter requests.
3) deploy a prompt-size reject filter at the proxy for public tier to return 400 for >10k tokens.
4) throttle automatic client-side retries via header rewrite.

alex: temp config changes:
```
# ingress config patch (applied)
admission_control:
  per_worker_queue_limit: 64  # was 32
  max_request_tokens: 10000  # reject larger
retry_hints:
  enforce_edge_header: true
```

maria: applied patch to ingress gw configs on us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Rolling to gw-a/b/c.

(90s)

maria: post-config: 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% cluster-wide. p95 latency down from 1.2s -> 640ms. Good signal.

irene: customer comms draft: "We're aware of elevated 5xx for /v1/generate, mitigation applied (routing + request gating). Intermittent errors should be reduced. We'll provide a full RCA once logs are analyzed." Share for review?

alex: LGTM. Add note that tenants with >10k token requests may see rejects; include steps to request temporary exception for large-batch migration windows.

sam: we're leaving tracing on for 25 more minutes and keeping the canary reroute until the root causes are confirmed.

ops-bot: Incident channel pinned doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INC/2253456789 (timeline + artifacts uploaded).

kyle: follow-up investigation pointers for RCA:
- correlate runtime queue_ms spikes with prompt_tokens and kv_cache_hit flag
- check client retry headers to quantify amplification factor per tenant
- review kernel and GPU driver logs for stalls during heavy decode loops
- verify autoscaler didn't fail to spin up new GPU-backed pods between 14:10-14:18Z

maria: planning an official incident postmortem doc. I'll own the timeline + customer impact sections. Alex will own technical root cause and remediation. Kyle will own follow-up changes and runtime hardening. Irene will own customer comms and support follow-ups. Sam will track rollout of the prompt-size gating in prod.

alex: handoff to next on-call in ~20m — leaving notes here. If anything regresses ping me @alex immediately.

irene: acknowledged. handing off to kyle for overnight watch. Kicking off P1 RCA board meeting at 17:00Z to go over traces and agree on long-term fixes.

kyle: taking over. thanks team. I'll keep the pinned log pack and start the hypothesis tracking doc now.

oncall-bot: Incident status => mitigated (partial). Severity: P2 (was P1). Actions: routing/canary + ingress gating. Next: full RCA in 24-48h.

(END OF THREAD)
